conclusion: One TQ4 key quantizer exists for every packed entry: prepare (norm, rotation) + pack_tq (codes). eb3.cuh, spq4.cuh, spq6.cuh (and eb4.cuh, eb2b.cuh) only read codes and norms made by it; packed_launcher.cuh only launches it. The census does not widen R2: the one fix in prepare covers the public route and every raw packed entry fed by ApaSpq1Workspace.
